A feature-rich, optimized script for Your Bizarre Adventure

Game: Your Bizarre Adventure (YBA)
UI Library: WindUI (Custom Fork)
Executor Compatibility: Script-Ware, Delta, Velocity(Instant TP warning for unsupported executors)

---

> Core Features

> Automated Farming:
- Dual Farming Modes: Normal & AFK with intelligent pathfinding
- Multi-Method Travel: Stud-step, Tween, and Instant teleportation
- Smart Targeting: Lucky Arrow priority, selective item farming, max stack detection
- Dynamic Selling: Auto-sell on max stacks, worthless item clearing, inventory management

> Stand & Rib Farming:
- Automated Stand Rolling: Complete Arrow/Rokakaka automation
- Pity System: Target pity amount with auto-kick when reached
- 28 Stand Selection: Toggle which stands to keep/sell
- Shiny Detection: Auto-preserve any shiny stands
- Rib Cage Farming: Full Saint's Corpse part automation

> Real-Time Stats:
- Live pity counter with percentage calculation
- Current stand & shiny display
- Stand wishlist tracking

> Visual Enhancements:
- Item ESP: Green/red highlight with item name labels
- Player ESP: Red fill/white outline with name tags
- Spawn Notifiers: Sound & popup alerts for specific items
- AFK Camera: Rotating cinematic camera during farming

> Performance & Utility:
- FPS Booster: Optimized lighting and shadow settings
- Anti-AFK: Built-in idle prevention
- Auto-Rejoin: Detects kicks and automatically rejoins server
- Config System: Save/load all settings with multiple profiles
- Theme Selector: 15+ UI themes included

> Trolling & Fun:
- Stand Pilot: Full stand control with adjustable speed
- Fly Hack: 3D movement with WASD controls
- Sticker: Attach player/stand to targets with multiple modes
- View Stand: Orbit camera for spectating your stand

> Level Farming:
- Automated quest completion based on player level
- Enemy targeting & killing
- Item collection for quests
- Stand utilization for combat

> SBR Optimized:
- Steel Ball Run Mode: Automatic detection with teleport presets
- Horse Controls: Speed/jump adjustments
- Barrier Teleports: Instant stage progression
- Player ESP: Red barrier no-clip options

> Integrated Shop:
- One-click purchase all items & specs
- Price display and confirmation
- Special dialogue triggers (Jesus, Halloween, etc.)

---

> Usage
1. Inject with a supported executor
2. Execute script (keybind: K to toggle UI)
3. Configure your preferences in the Settings tab
4. Enable desired features - the script handles the rest!

---

> Important Notes
- Instant Travel: May kick on unsupported executors (use Stud/Tween for safety)
- AFK Mode: Requires "Enable Farming" to be active
- Pity Farming: Will kick you when target pity is reached
- SBR Features: Only load when in Steel Ball Run

---

Credits: Zakori, Hori, Coowner-Diablo, Owner-Azurey
Discord: Copy link in About tab

➤ Diablo YBA Hub is a clean and powerful script made to make farming in YBA simple, fast, and automatic. Recommended Setup

➤ Auto Sell on Max: ON to prevent overfilling inventory.
➤ Use Sell All Worthless to instantly clear junk items.

scripts.features:
This script allows you to farm lucky arrows extremely fast by farming items and then selling them ( then it buys the arrow from the shop )

So it gets rid of the rng.
scripts.script:
wait(5) -- remove or increase if your executor stops injecting

getgenv().WaitBeforeItem = 0.3 -- ( seconds ) increase to 0.5, 0.7, 1 etc if kick

getgenv().WebHookName = "" --put webhook here, if you want to get notifs about lucky arrow / mod in server

getgenv().SellItemsOnMax = true -- Sells items when they reach the max otherwise false to sell instantly when u get one

getgenv().NotSupported = true -- VERY IMPORTANT, if your executor is bad ENABLE this, so it doesnt crash.
 
getgenv().stepDistance = 35 --make tp go faster 
 
getgenv().timeuntilitemcheck = 10 --How much time the script waits until it checks if it theres an item on the map, that you selected.
 
getgenv().GameIDtoHopTo = 1649559 --Essentially JJSploit and Solara ( and other bad execs) can't serverhop using roblox api, so we first hop to this game id, and then we hop back into YBA, so it will change the servers.
 
 

--Those items will be farmed and those that CAN be sold will be sold by script
--then it buys lucky arrow
getgenv().WhatToFarm = {
    ["Lucky Arrow"] = true,
